svg.title: Three logged requests, drawn as cost bars to scale. "Define latency in one sentence" on gpt-5.6-luna cost $0.000120. "Summarize why prompt caching reduces cost" on gpt-5.6-luna cost $0.000561. "Analyze the tradeoffs of model routing" on gpt-5.6-sol, five times the price, cost $0.035320. The total was $0.036001, and the one premium request was 98 percent of the bill.
